info.description: DATABASE_SCHEMA.md §6.1. No plaintext phone/address attribute exists by design — see src/api/customer/services/pii-crypto.ts. Callers submit plaintext phone/address only to the custom controller actions, which encrypt before persisting.

client_uuid.description: Set when the customer was created offline (REQUIREMENTS.md §0.3).

phone_enc.description: AES-256-GCM ciphertext of the phone number, base64. Equivalent to BYTEA via pgcrypto in the SQL spec — see pii-crypto.ts for the rationale.

phone_hash.description: Deterministic HMAC-SHA256 (hex) of the normalised phone number, for exact lookup and the (store, phone_hash) uniqueness constraint (migration-enforced).

address_enc.description: AES-256-GCM ciphertext of the address, base64.

credit_limit_paise.description: 0 means no limit when credit_limit_enabled = false (Rule CR-1).

current_balance_paise.description: CACHED mirror of the last customer_ledger_entries.running_balance_paise. Never the source of truth (Rule LED-2) — written only by ledger.service.ts.

tags.description: Equivalent to TEXT[] in the SQL spec; stored as a JSON string array.
